answer.read: Nordmark announced +6.5% (doc:20260914-70510-P02), citing copper +47.7% at 20% of its cost, which news:20260910-27 confirms. Should-cost cost:350011 is about €375, so at the quoted €370.96 it sits near or below a sustainable margin. Under the stabilise goal, a relationship charge applies if we squeeze it. Its history shows it settles well below its ask (asked +4.7%, settled +1.2%). OTD of 90.4% against the 95% target is a weakness on its side. It mainly fears copper exposure and is under cash pressure, so a clause and longer payment terms meet its real needs.
answer.message: Thank you for your offer and for the clear breakdown of your cost drivers. We accept that copper has moved sharply. Rather than a flat increase, we propose sharing that risk transparently through a copper clause, combined with longer payment terms that ease your working capital. On that basis we can offer a more moderate price adjustment, as set out in the enclosed term sheet.
answer.reason: E0 gives our lowest C (€2,251,155 against €2,259,998 for o8 and €2,273,259 for o7). The wide deadband keeps the clause cheap for us. The sheet is still worth about 5% more to the supplier than its own sheet, so acceptance is likely and its margin is protected for the stabilise goal. Citing our rising volume and our order history supports the moderate price without leaking anything.
